title: Determinant-one real Möbius maps biject the upper half-plane
statement: Let a,b,c,d be real numbers satisfying ad−bc=1. Define H={z∈ℂ : Im(z)>0} and the total complex function M(z)=(az+b)/(cz+d), with real coefficients embedded in ℂ. Then M maps H into H, is injective on H, and is surjective from H onto H.
lean_statement: ∀ (a b c d : ℝ), a * d - b * c = 1 → Set.BijOn (fun z : ℂ => ((a : ℂ) * z + (b : ℂ)) / ((c : ℂ) * z + (d : ℂ))) {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im}
